d: Democratic strategist Ravi Gupta and Republican strategist Leslie Shedd tell Bloomberg This Weekend that the 2028 presidential race remains wide open as both parties assess the lessons of the midterms and potential candidates begin defining their messages. Gupta, founder and CEO of The Branch, and Shedd, president of Rising Communications, tell hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that affordability will remain central to both parties while Democrats weigh investigations of the Trump administration and Republicans reconsider their messaging after their midterm losses.
